label: Guillaume Boreau

claims.statement: Royal notary who drew up the will.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Will of 23 April 1519.

claims.statement: The will of 23 April 1519 was received by Guillaume Boreau, royal notary of the bailiwick of Amboise. The original is lost; the text survives in later copies.

sources.cite: Richter, The Notebooks of Leonardo da Vinci, section 1566 (text of the will, English), online mirror. Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

Amoretti, Memorie storiche su la vita, gli studj e le opere di Lionardo da Vinci (1804), page image on Wikisource (Italian text of the will). Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

open_questions: Where is the earliest surviving copy of the will held, and who first printed it (Amoretti 1804 cites a copy)?

timeline.text: Royal notary who drew up the will.
